/-!
# Restricted second-moment bounds for a likelihood-ratio profile

This module keeps the profile split generic.  Outside a measurable retained
set, the positive likelihood residual is bounded by the likelihood itself.
Inside the retained set, the finite-measure positive-part inequality preserves
the retained reference mass in the Cauchy--Schwarz factor.
-/

open MeasureTheory Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- A likelihood-ratio hockey-stick profile is the real positive-part integral,
embedded into `ENNReal`. -/
theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_eq_ofReal_integral_positivePart
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatio : Measurable ratio) (hRatioNonnegative : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ ratio sample)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    (epsilon : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
        (reference : Measure X) epsilon =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (∫ sample, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X)) := by
  rw [eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward reference ratio hRatio
    hRatioNonnegative epsilon]
  have hpositiveIntegrable : Integrable
      (fun sample => max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0)
      (reference : Measure X) :=
    (hRatioIntegrable.sub (integrable_const _)).pos_part
  have hnonnegative : ∀ᵐ sample ∂(reference : Measure X),
      0 ≤ max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0 :=
    ae_of_all _ fun sample => le_max_right _ _
  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hpositiveIntegrable hnonnegative]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro sample
  by_cases h : 0 ≤ ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon
  · rw [max_eq_left h]
  · have h' : ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge h
    rw [max_eq_right h']
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos h']

/-- Split a likelihood-ratio profile at a measurable retained set and control
the retained residual by its centered second moment. -/
theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_le_restrictedSecondMoment
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatio : Measurable ratio) (hRatioNonnegative : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ ratio sample)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    (retained : Set X) (hRetained : MeasurableSet retained)
    (epsilon : Real)
    (hCenteredSquare : Integrable
      (fun sample => (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2)
      ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained)) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
        (reference : Measure X) epsilon ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal
        ((∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
          (Real.sqrt
              (((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ *
                ∫ sample in retained,
                  (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2
                    ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
            (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) -
              Real.exp epsilon *
                ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ) / 2) := by
  rw [eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_eq_ofReal_integral_positivePart
    reference ratio hRatio hRatioNonnegative hRatioIntegrable epsilon]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hpositiveIntegrable : Integrable
      (fun sample => max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0)
      (reference : Measure X) :=
    (hRatioIntegrable.sub (integrable_const _)).pos_part
  have houtside :
      (∫ sample in retainedᶜ, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X)) ≤
        ∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X) := by
    apply integral_mono_ae
    · exact hpositiveIntegrable.integrableOn
    · exact hRatioIntegrable.integrableOn
    · filter_upwards with sample
      by_cases h : ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon ≤ 0
      · simp [max_eq_right h, hRatioNonnegative sample]
      · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge h)]
        linarith [Real.exp_pos epsilon]
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained) := by
    infer_instance
  have hinside := integral_positivePart_le_of_integrable_sq
    ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained) ratio (Real.exp epsilon)
    hRatio.aestronglyMeasurable hCenteredSquare
  calc
    (∫ sample, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
        ∂(reference : Measure X)) =
        (∫ sample in retained, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
        ∫ sample in retainedᶜ, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X) :=
      (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl hRetained hpositiveIntegrable).symm
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt
              (((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ *
                ∫ sample in retained,
                  (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2
                    ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
            (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) -
              Real.exp epsilon *
                ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ) / 2 +
          (∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) :=
      add_le_add hinside houtside
    _ = (∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
        (Real.sqrt
              (((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ *
                ∫ sample in retained,
                  (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2
                    ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
            (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) -
              Real.exp epsilon *
                ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ) / 2 :=
      add_comm _ _

/-- The same restricted bound, capped by the retained likelihood mass. -/
theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_le_restrictedSecondMomentCapped
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatio : Measurable ratio) (hRatioNonnegative : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ ratio sample)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    (retained : Set X) (hRetained : MeasurableSet retained)
    (epsilon : Real)
    (hCenteredSquare : Integrable
      (fun sample => (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2)
      ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained)) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
        (reference : Measure X) epsilon ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal
        ((∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
          min (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X))
            ((Real.sqrt
                (((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ *
                  ∫ sample in retained,
                    (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2
                      ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
              (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) -
                Real.exp epsilon *
                  ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ) / 2)) := by
  rw [eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_eq_ofReal_integral_positivePart
    reference ratio hRatio hRatioNonnegative hRatioIntegrable epsilon]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hpositiveIntegrable : Integrable
      (fun sample => max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0)
      (reference : Measure X) :=
    (hRatioIntegrable.sub (integrable_const _)).pos_part
  have hresidualLeRatio : ∀ sample,
      max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0 ≤ ratio sample := by
    intro sample
    by_cases h : ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon ≤ 0
    · simp [max_eq_right h, hRatioNonnegative sample]
    · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge h)]
      linarith [Real.exp_pos epsilon]
  have houtside :
      (∫ sample in retainedᶜ, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X)) ≤
        ∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X) := by
    apply integral_mono_ae hpositiveIntegrable.integrableOn hRatioIntegrable.integrableOn
    exact ae_of_all _ hresidualLeRatio
  have hinsideMass :
      (∫ sample in retained, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X)) ≤
        ∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X) := by
    apply integral_mono_ae hpositiveIntegrable.integrableOn hRatioIntegrable.integrableOn
    exact ae_of_all _ hresidualLeRatio
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained) := by
    infer_instance
  have hinsideSecond := integral_positivePart_le_of_integrable_sq
    ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained) ratio (Real.exp epsilon)
    hRatio.aestronglyMeasurable hCenteredSquare
  calc
    (∫ sample, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
        ∂(reference : Measure X)) =
        (∫ sample in retained, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
        ∫ sample in retainedᶜ, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
          ∂(reference : Measure X) :=
      (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl hRetained hpositiveIntegrable).symm
    _ ≤ min (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X))
          ((Real.sqrt
              (((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ *
                ∫ sample in retained,
                  (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2
                    ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
            (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) -
              Real.exp epsilon *
                ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ) / 2) +
        (∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) :=
      add_le_add (le_min hinsideMass hinsideSecond) houtside
    _ = (∫ sample in retainedᶜ, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
        min (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X))
          ((Real.sqrt
              (((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ *
                ∫ sample in retained,
                  (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) ^ 2
                    ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
            (∫ sample in retained, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X)) -
              Real.exp epsilon *
                ((reference : Measure X).restrict retained).real Set.univ) / 2) :=
      add_comm _ _

end

/-!
# Finite-bracket calibration adapters

This owner converts verified lower and upper profile certificates into bounds
on the existing calibrated standard-deviation infimum.  The lower endpoint
uses a strict profile violation.  Its infimum conclusion explicitly retains
feasible-set nonemptiness; the upper endpoint itself supplies that fact and
does not require attainment of the infimum.
-/

open Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- A strict lower profile certificate rules out a candidate noise level. -/
theorem sampledGaussian_candidate_infeasible_of_lower_profile_certificate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) (candidate : NNReal)
    (certificate : ENNReal)
    (hLower : ENNReal.ofReal delta < certificate)
    (hProfile : certificate ≤
      sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity candidate epsilon) :
    candidate ∉ sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta := by
  intro hFeasible
  have hCandidate := (mem_sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet_iff horizon
    samplingRate hRate sensitivity epsilon delta candidate).1 hFeasible
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hProfile.trans hCandidate)) hLower

/-- An upper profile certificate makes its candidate feasible and hence bounds
the calibrated infimum without an attainment premise. -/
theorem sampledGaussian_calibratedStddev_le_of_upper_profile_certificate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) (candidate : NNReal)
    (certificate : ENNReal)
    (hProfile : sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity candidate epsilon ≤ certificate)
    (hUpper : certificate ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta) :
    sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity epsilon delta ≤
      candidate := by
  apply sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev_le_of_feasible horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon delta candidate
  exact (mem_sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet_iff horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon delta candidate).2 (hProfile.trans hUpper)

/-- An upper profile certificate also supplies the nonemptiness needed for a
lower bound on the totalized infimum. -/
theorem sampledGaussian_feasibleSet_nonempty_of_upper_profile_certificate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) (candidate : NNReal)
    (certificate : ENNReal)
    (hProfile : sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity candidate epsilon ≤ certificate)
    (hUpper : certificate ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta) :
    (sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta).Nonempty := by
  refine ⟨candidate, ?_⟩
  exact (mem_sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet_iff horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon delta candidate).2 (hProfile.trans hUpper)

/-- A strict lower certificate bounds the calibrated infimum when the feasible
set is known to be nonempty. -/
theorem sampledGaussian_lower_bound_of_lower_profile_certificate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) (candidate : NNReal)
    (certificate : ENNReal)
    (hLower : ENNReal.ofReal delta < certificate)
    (hProfile : certificate ≤
      sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity candidate epsilon)
    (hNonempty : (sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta).Nonempty) :
    candidate ≤ sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta := by
  exact le_sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev_of_not_feasible horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon delta candidate hNonempty
    (sampledGaussian_candidate_infeasible_of_lower_profile_certificate horizon
      samplingRate hRate sensitivity epsilon delta candidate certificate hLower hProfile)

/-- Paired profile certificates give a calibration interval without assuming
that the calibrated infimum is attained. -/
theorem sampledGaussian_calibration_interval_of_paired_profile_certificates
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real)
    (lowerCandidate upperCandidate : NNReal)
    (lowerCertificate upperCertificate : ENNReal)
    (hLower : ENNReal.ofReal delta < lowerCertificate)
    (hLowerProfile : lowerCertificate ≤
      sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity lowerCandidate epsilon)
    (hUpperProfile : sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity upperCandidate epsilon ≤ upperCertificate)
    (hUpper : upperCertificate ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta) :
    lowerCandidate ≤ sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity epsilon delta ∧
      sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity epsilon delta ≤
        upperCandidate := by
  have hNonempty := sampledGaussian_feasibleSet_nonempty_of_upper_profile_certificate
    horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity epsilon delta upperCandidate upperCertificate
    hUpperProfile hUpper
  constructor
  · exact sampledGaussian_lower_bound_of_lower_profile_certificate horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta lowerCandidate lowerCertificate hLower hLowerProfile hNonempty
  · exact sampledGaussian_calibratedStddev_le_of_upper_profile_certificate horizon samplingRate
      hRate sensitivity epsilon delta upperCandidate upperCertificate hUpperProfile hUpper

/-- A supplied maximum-event threshold whose lower expression exceeds the
privacy target certifies that a positive candidate is infeasible. -/
theorem sampledGaussian_candidate_infeasible_of_maximumEvent_certificate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta threshold : Real) (candidate : NNReal)
    (hCandidate : 0 < candidate)
    (hLower : ENNReal.ofReal delta <
      sparseGaussianProductMaximumEventForwardLowerBound horizon samplingRate hRate
        (sensitivity / (candidate : Real)) epsilon threshold) :
    candidate ∉ sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta := by
  apply sampledGaussian_candidate_infeasible_of_lower_profile_certificate horizon
    samplingRate hRate sensitivity epsilon delta candidate
    (sparseGaussianProductMaximumEventForwardLowerBound horizon samplingRate hRate
      (sensitivity / (candidate : Real)) epsilon threshold) hLower
  simpa [sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev] using
    sampledGaussianProductMaximumEventLowerBound_le_binaryProfile horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon threshold candidate hCandidate

/-- Supplied forward and reciprocal-reverse thresholds whose finite binary
upper expression meets the target certify feasibility and an upper bound on
calibrated noise. -/
theorem sampledGaussian_calibratedStddev_le_of_finiteBracketWithThresholds_upper_certificate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta forwardThreshold reverseThreshold : Real)
    (candidate : NNReal)
    (hCandidate : 0 < candidate)
    (hUpper : sampledGaussianProductFiniteProfileUpperBoundWithThresholds horizon samplingRate
      sensitivity epsilon forwardThreshold reverseThreshold candidate ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta) :

theorem sampledGaussian_calibratedStddev_le_of_finiteBracket_upper_certificate

import Mf.DP.SparseGaussianTruncatedLikelihoodMoments

/-!
# Restricted second-moment upper bounds for sparse Gaussian products

The closed form retains the reference below-box mass in both the centered
square and the Cauchy--Schwarz factor.  It therefore avoids the artificial
outside-box penalty caused by zero-extending the truncated likelihood.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

def sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMass
    (horizon : Nat) (threshold : Real) : Real :=
  (stdNormalCDFReal threshold) ^ horizon

def sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift threshold : Real) : Real :=
  ((1 - (samplingRate : Real)) * stdNormalCDFReal threshold +
    (samplingRate : Real) *
      stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - standardizedShift)) ^ horizon

def sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxSecondMoment
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift threshold : Real) : Real :=
  ((1 - (samplingRate : Real)) ^ 2 * stdNormalCDFReal threshold +
    2 * (samplingRate : Real) * (1 - (samplingRate : Real)) *
      stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - standardizedShift) +
    (samplingRate : Real) ^ 2 * Real.exp (standardizedShift ^ 2) *
      stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - 2 * standardizedShift)) ^ horizon

def sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxCenteredSecondMoment
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift threshold coefficient : Real) : Real :=
  sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxSecondMoment horizon samplingRate standardizedShift threshold -
    2 * coefficient *
      sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment horizon samplingRate standardizedShift threshold +
    coefficient ^ 2 * sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMass horizon threshold

def sparseGaussianProductRestrictedSecondMomentResidual
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift threshold coefficient : Real) : Real :=
  (Real.sqrt
      (sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMass horizon threshold *
        sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxCenteredSecondMoment horizon samplingRate
          standardizedShift threshold coefficient) +
    sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment horizon samplingRate standardizedShift threshold -
      coefficient * sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMass horizon threshold) / 2

/-- The real forward upper formula before the optional residual mass cap. -/
def sparseGaussianProductForwardRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBoundReal
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : Real :=
  1 - sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment horizon samplingRate
      standardizedShift threshold +
    sparseGaussianProductRestrictedSecondMomentResidual horizon samplingRate
      standardizedShift threshold (Real.exp epsilon)

def sparseGaussianProductForwardRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : ENNReal :=
  ENNReal.ofReal
    (sparseGaussianProductForwardRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBoundReal horizon
      samplingRate standardizedShift epsilon threshold)

/-- The selected numerical-facing upper formula caps the below-box residual by
the complete below-box source mass. -/
def sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBoundReal
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : Real :=
  1 - sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment horizon samplingRate
      standardizedShift threshold +
    min (sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment horizon samplingRate
      standardizedShift threshold)
      (sparseGaussianProductRestrictedSecondMomentResidual horizon samplingRate
        standardizedShift threshold (Real.exp epsilon))

def sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : ENNReal :=
  ENNReal.ofReal
    (sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBoundReal horizon
      samplingRate standardizedShift epsilon threshold)

theorem sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxCenteredSecondMoment_nonneg
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift threshold coefficient : Real) :
    0 ≤ sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxCenteredSecondMoment horizon samplingRate
      standardizedShift threshold coefficient := by
  exact sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_closedCenteredSquare_nonneg
    horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift threshold coefficient

/-- The normalized forward profile is bounded by the restricted below-box
second-moment formula for every threshold. -/
theorem sparseGaussianProductForwardProfile_le_restrictedSecondMomentUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        (sparseGaussianProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift :
          Measure (Fin horizon → Real))
        (standardGaussianProductLaw horizon : Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) epsilon ≤
      sparseGaussianProductForwardRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound horizon samplingRate
        standardizedShift epsilon threshold := by
  change eventHockeyStickProfile
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon =>
        (sparseGaussianMixtureLaw samplingRate hRate standardizedShift : Measure Real)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1)) epsilon ≤ _
  rw [sparseGaussianProductLaw_eq_withDensity horizon samplingRate hRate
    standardizedShift]
  let reference : ProbabilityMeasure (Fin horizon → Real) :=
    ⟨Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1), by infer_instance⟩
  have hbound := eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_le_restrictedSecondMoment
    reference
    (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real) standardizedShift)
    (measurable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
    (fun sample => (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_pos horizon samplingRate hRate
      standardizedShift sample).le)
    (integrable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
    (sparseGaussianProductBelowBox horizon threshold)
    (measurableSet_sparseGaussianProductBelowBox horizon threshold)
    epsilon
    (integrable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_sub_const_sq_belowBox horizon
      samplingRate standardizedShift threshold (Real.exp epsilon))
  have hreference : (reference : Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1) := rfl
  rw [hreference] at hbound
  unfold sparseGaussianProductForwardRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound
  unfold sparseGaussianProductForwardRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBoundReal
  unfold sparseGaussianProductRestrictedSecondMomentResidual
  have hcomplement := setIntegral_compl
    (measurableSet_sparseGaussianProductBelowBox horizon threshold)
    (integrable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
  rw [integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
    standardizedShift] at hcomplement
  rw [hcomplement] at hbound
  rw [integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_belowBox horizon samplingRate hRate
    standardizedShift threshold] at hbound
  have hcentered :=
    integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_sub_const_sq_belowBox_eq horizon
      samplingRate hRate standardizedShift threshold (Real.exp epsilon)
  unfold sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMeasure at hcentered
  rw [hcentered] at hbound
  have hmass := sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMeasure_real_univ horizon threshold
  unfold sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMeasure at hmass
  rw [hmass] at hbound
  simpa [sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMass,
    sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment,
    sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxSecondMoment,
    sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxCenteredSecondMoment,
    standardGaussianProductLaw] using hbound

/-- The normalized forward profile obeys the selected mass-capped bound. -/
theorem sparseGaussianProductForwardProfile_le_cappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        (sparseGaussianProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift :
          Measure (Fin horizon → Real))
        (standardGaussianProductLaw horizon : Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) epsilon ≤
      sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound horizon
        samplingRate standardizedShift epsilon threshold := by
  change eventHockeyStickProfile
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon =>
        (sparseGaussianMixtureLaw samplingRate hRate standardizedShift : Measure Real)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1)) epsilon ≤ _
  rw [sparseGaussianProductLaw_eq_withDensity horizon samplingRate hRate
    standardizedShift]
  let reference : ProbabilityMeasure (Fin horizon → Real) :=
    ⟨Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1), by infer_instance⟩
  have hbound :=
    eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_le_restrictedSecondMomentCapped
      reference
      (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
        standardizedShift)
      (measurable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
        standardizedShift)
      (fun sample => (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_pos horizon samplingRate hRate
        standardizedShift sample).le)
      (integrable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
        standardizedShift)
      (sparseGaussianProductBelowBox horizon threshold)
      (measurableSet_sparseGaussianProductBelowBox horizon threshold)
      epsilon
      (integrable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_sub_const_sq_belowBox horizon
        samplingRate standardizedShift threshold (Real.exp epsilon))
  have hreference : (reference : Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1) := rfl
  rw [hreference] at hbound
  unfold sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound
  unfold sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBoundReal
  unfold sparseGaussianProductRestrictedSecondMomentResidual
  have hcomplement := setIntegral_compl
    (measurableSet_sparseGaussianProductBelowBox horizon threshold)
    (integrable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
  rw [integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
    standardizedShift] at hcomplement
  rw [hcomplement] at hbound
  rw [integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_belowBox horizon samplingRate hRate
    standardizedShift threshold] at hbound
  have hcentered :=
    integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_sub_const_sq_belowBox_eq horizon
      samplingRate hRate standardizedShift threshold (Real.exp epsilon)
  unfold sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMeasure at hcentered
  rw [hcentered] at hbound
  have hmass := sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMeasure_real_univ horizon threshold
  unfold sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMeasure at hmass
  rw [hmass] at hbound
  simpa [sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxReferenceMass,
    sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxFirstMoment,
    sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxSecondMoment,
    sparseGaussianProductBelowBoxCenteredSecondMoment,
    standardGaussianProductLaw] using hbound

end

end Mf.DP

import Mf.DP.FiniteProfileCoefficientDuality
import Mf.DP.SparseGaussianProductForwardUpperBound

/-!
# Reverse sparse-Gaussian product profile bounds

The direct mixture likelihood is bounded below by the probability that no
coordinate participates.  This gives a simple finite reverse hockey-stick
upper bound without any reciprocal-coefficient transport.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

def sparseGaussianProductReverseLikelihoodFloorUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (epsilon : Real) : ENNReal :=
  ENNReal.ofReal
    (1 - Real.exp epsilon * (1 - (samplingRate : Real)) ^ horizon)

def sparseGaussianProductReverseReciprocalUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : ENNReal :=
  ENNReal.ofReal
    (1 - Real.exp epsilon + Real.exp epsilon *
      (sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound horizon
        samplingRate standardizedShift (-epsilon) threshold).toReal)

def sparseGaussianProductReverseBestUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : ENNReal :=
  min (sparseGaussianProductReverseReciprocalUpperBound horizon samplingRate
      standardizedShift epsilon threshold)
    (sparseGaussianProductReverseLikelihoodFloorUpperBound horizon samplingRate epsilon)

/-- The reverse normalized product profile is controlled by the unsampled-mass
likelihood floor. -/
theorem sparseGaussianProductReverseProfile_le_likelihoodFloorUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        (standardGaussianProductLaw horizon : Measure (Fin horizon → Real))
        (sparseGaussianProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift :
          Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) epsilon ≤
      sparseGaussianProductReverseLikelihoodFloorUpperBound horizon samplingRate epsilon := by
  change eventHockeyStickProfile
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon =>
        (sparseGaussianMixtureLaw samplingRate hRate standardizedShift : Measure Real)))
      epsilon ≤ _
  rw [sparseGaussianProductLaw_eq_withDensity horizon samplingRate hRate
    standardizedShift]
  let reference : ProbabilityMeasure (Fin horizon → Real) :=
    ⟨Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1), by infer_instance⟩
  have hreverse := eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_reverse reference
    (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real) standardizedShift)
    (measurable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
    (fun sample => (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_pos horizon samplingRate hRate
      standardizedShift sample).le)
    epsilon
  have hreference : (reference : Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1) := rfl
  rw [hreference] at hreverse
  rw [hreverse]
  unfold sparseGaussianProductReverseLikelihoodFloorUpperBound
  calc
    (∫⁻ sample, ENNReal.ofReal
        (1 - Real.exp epsilon *
          sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
            standardizedShift sample)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1)) ≤
      ∫⁻ _sample : Fin horizon → Real, ENNReal.ofReal
        (1 - Real.exp epsilon * (1 - (samplingRate : Real)) ^ horizon)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro sample
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      have hfloor := sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_ge_floor horizon samplingRate hRate
        standardizedShift sample
      exact sub_le_sub_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfloor (Real.exp_pos epsilon).le) 1
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal
        (1 - Real.exp epsilon * (1 - (samplingRate : Real)) ^ horizon) := by
      simp

/-- Reciprocal-coefficient reverse upper bound obtained from the forward bound
through the safe real-valued duality theorem. -/
theorem sparseGaussianProductReverseProfile_le_reciprocalUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        (standardGaussianProductLaw horizon : Measure (Fin horizon → Real))
        (sparseGaussianProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift :
          Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) epsilon ≤
      sparseGaussianProductReverseReciprocalUpperBound horizon samplingRate
        standardizedShift epsilon threshold := by
  change eventHockeyStickProfile
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon =>
        (sparseGaussianMixtureLaw samplingRate hRate standardizedShift : Measure Real)))
      epsilon ≤ _
  rw [sparseGaussianProductLaw_eq_withDensity horizon samplingRate hRate
    standardizedShift]
  let reference : ProbabilityMeasure (Fin horizon → Real) :=
    ⟨Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1), by infer_instance⟩
  have hdual := eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_reverse_duality reference
    (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real) standardizedShift)
    (measurable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
    (fun sample => (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_pos horizon samplingRate hRate
      standardizedShift sample).le)
    (integrable_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
    (integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
      standardizedShift)
    epsilon
  have hreference : (reference : Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1) := rfl
  rw [hreference] at hdual
  rw [hdual]
  unfold sparseGaussianProductReverseReciprocalUpperBound
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hforwardBound :=
    sparseGaussianProductForwardProfile_le_cappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound
      horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift (-epsilon) threshold
  change eventHockeyStickProfile
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon =>
        (sparseGaussianMixtureLaw samplingRate hRate standardizedShift : Measure Real)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1)) (-epsilon) ≤ _
      at hforwardBound
  rw [sparseGaussianProductLaw_eq_withDensity horizon samplingRate hRate
    standardizedShift] at hforwardBound
  have htoReal :
      (eventHockeyStickProfile
        ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1).withDensity
          fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal
            (sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
              standardizedShift sample))
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1) (-epsilon)).toReal ≤
      (sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound horizon
        samplingRate standardizedShift (-epsilon) threshold).toReal := by
    apply ENNReal.toReal_mono
    · simp [sparseGaussianProductForwardCappedRestrictedSecondMomentUpperBound]
    · exact hforwardBound
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htoReal (Real.exp_pos epsilon).le]

/-- The selected reverse bound is the minimum of two independently verified
upper bounds. -/
theorem sparseGaussianProductReverseProfile_le_bestUpperBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        (standardGaussianProductLaw horizon : Measure (Fin horizon → Real))
        (sparseGaussianProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift :
          Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) epsilon ≤
      sparseGaussianProductReverseBestUpperBound horizon samplingRate
        standardizedShift epsilon threshold := by
  apply le_min
  · exact sparseGaussianProductReverseProfile_le_reciprocalUpperBound horizon
      samplingRate hRate standardizedShift epsilon threshold
  · exact sparseGaussianProductReverseProfile_le_likelihoodFloorUpperBound horizon
      samplingRate hRate standardizedShift epsilon

end

end Mf.DP
import Mf.DP.LikelihoodRatioHockeyStick

/-!
# Coefficient duality for density hockey-stick profiles

The profile is represented in `ENNReal`, so the signed constant `1 - alpha`
must be handled in a real-valued identity before re-embedding with
`ENNReal.ofReal`.  Direct `ENNReal` subtraction would be incorrect when
`alpha > 1`.
-/

open MeasureTheory Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

def realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real) (coefficient : Real) : Real :=
  ∫ sample, max (ratio sample - coefficient) 0 ∂(reference : Measure X)

def realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real) (coefficient : Real) : Real :=
  ∫ sample, max (1 - coefficient⁻¹ * ratio sample) 0 ∂(reference : Measure X)

theorem realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity_nonneg
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real) (coefficient : Real) :
    0 ≤ realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity reference ratio coefficient := by
  unfold realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity
  exact integral_nonneg fun sample => le_max_right _ _

theorem realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity_nonneg
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real) (coefficient : Real) :
    0 ≤ realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity reference ratio coefficient := by
  unfold realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity
  exact integral_nonneg fun sample => le_max_right _ _

theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_eq_ofReal_realProfile
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatio : Measurable ratio) (hRatioNonnegative : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ ratio sample)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    (epsilon : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
        (reference : Measure X) epsilon =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity reference ratio (Real.exp epsilon)) := by
  rw [eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward reference ratio hRatio
    hRatioNonnegative epsilon]
  change (∫⁻ sample, ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon)
      ∂(reference : Measure X)) =
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ sample, max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0
      ∂(reference : Measure X))
  have hpositive : Integrable (fun sample => max (ratio sample - Real.exp epsilon) 0)
      (reference : Measure X) :=
    (hRatioIntegrable.sub (integrable_const _)).pos_part
  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hpositive
    (ae_of_all _ fun sample => le_max_right _ _)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro sample
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_max,
    ENNReal.ofReal_sub (ratio sample) (Real.exp_pos epsilon).le]
  simpa using (max_eq_left (bot_le : (0 : ENNReal) ≤ _)).symm

theorem realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity_coefficient_duality
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    (hRatioIntegral : ∫ sample, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X) = 1)
    {coefficient : Real} (hCoefficient : 0 < coefficient) :
    realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity reference ratio coefficient =
      1 - coefficient + coefficient *
        realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity reference ratio coefficient := by
  let reverse : X → Real :=
    fun sample => max (1 - coefficient⁻¹ * ratio sample) 0
  have hreverse : Integrable reverse (reference : Measure X) :=
    ((integrable_const 1).sub
      (hRatioIntegrable.const_mul coefficient⁻¹)).pos_part
  have hforward : Integrable (fun sample => max (ratio sample - coefficient) 0)
      (reference : Measure X) :=
    (hRatioIntegrable.sub (integrable_const _)).pos_part
  have hpoint : ∀ sample, max (ratio sample - coefficient) 0 =
      ratio sample - coefficient + coefficient * reverse sample := by
    intro sample
    dsimp [reverse]
    by_cases hle : coefficient ≤ ratio sample
    · rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hle), max_eq_right]
      · field_simp
        ring
      · have hscale : 1 ≤ coefficient⁻¹ * ratio sample := by
          calc
            1 = coefficient⁻¹ * coefficient := by field_simp
            _ ≤ coefficient⁻¹ * ratio sample :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (inv_nonneg.mpr hCoefficient.le)
        exact sub_nonpos.mpr hscale
    · rw [max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr (le_of_not_ge hle))]
      have hlt : ratio sample < coefficient := lt_of_not_ge hle
      have hscaled : coefficient⁻¹ * ratio sample < 1 := by
        rw [inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hCoefficient]
        simpa using hlt
      rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hscaled.le)]
      field_simp
      ring
  unfold realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity
  unfold realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity
  calc
    (∫ sample, max (ratio sample - coefficient) 0 ∂(reference : Measure X)) =
        ∫ sample, ratio sample - coefficient + coefficient * reverse sample
          ∂(reference : Measure X) :=
      integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ hpoint)
    _ = (∫ sample, ratio sample - coefficient ∂(reference : Measure X)) +
        ∫ sample, coefficient * reverse sample ∂(reference : Measure X) :=
      integral_add (hRatioIntegrable.sub (integrable_const coefficient))
        (hreverse.const_mul coefficient)
    _ = 1 - coefficient + coefficient *
        ∫ sample, reverse sample ∂(reference : Measure X) := by
      rw [integral_sub hRatioIntegrable (integrable_const _), integral_const,
        integral_const_mul, hRatioIntegral]
      simp [Measure.real, measure_univ]

theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_reverse_eq_ofReal_realProfile
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatio : Measurable ratio) (hRatioNonnegative : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ ratio sample)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    {coefficient : Real} (hCoefficient : 0 < coefficient) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile (reference : Measure X)
        ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
        (-Real.log coefficient) =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity reference ratio coefficient) := by
  rw [eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_reverse reference ratio hRatio
    hRatioNonnegative (-Real.log coefficient)]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-Real.log coefficient) = coefficient⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hCoefficient]
  rw [hexp]
  let reverse : X → Real :=
    fun sample => max (1 - coefficient⁻¹ * ratio sample) 0
  have hreverse : Integrable reverse (reference : Measure X) :=
    ((integrable_const 1).sub
      (hRatioIntegrable.const_mul coefficient⁻¹)).pos_part
  change (∫⁻ sample, ENNReal.ofReal (1 - coefficient⁻¹ * ratio sample)
      ∂(reference : Measure X)) =
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ sample, reverse sample ∂(reference : Measure X))
  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hreverse
    (ae_of_all _ fun sample => le_max_right _ _)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro sample
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_max, ENNReal.ofReal_sub]
  · simpa using (max_eq_left (bot_le : (0 : ENNReal) ≤ _)).symm
  · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hCoefficient.le) (hRatioNonnegative sample)

/-- Safe coefficient duality for an exact density profile. The signed constant
is evaluated in `Real`, not by truncated `ENNReal` subtraction. -/
theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_coefficient_duality
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatio : Measurable ratio) (hRatioNonnegative : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ ratio sample)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    (hRatioIntegral : ∫ sample, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X) = 1)
    {coefficient : Real} (hCoefficient : 0 < coefficient) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile
        ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
        (reference : Measure X) (Real.log coefficient) =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (1 - coefficient + coefficient *
          (eventHockeyStickProfile (reference : Measure X)
            ((reference : Measure X).withDensity
              (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
            (-Real.log coefficient)).toReal) := by
  have hforward := eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_eq_ofReal_realProfile
    reference ratio hRatio hRatioNonnegative hRatioIntegrable (Real.log coefficient)
  have hreverse := eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_reverse_eq_ofReal_realProfile
    reference ratio hRatio hRatioNonnegative hRatioIntegrable hCoefficient
  have hreal := realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity_coefficient_duality reference ratio
    hRatioIntegrable hRatioIntegral hCoefficient
  have hforward' :
      eventHockeyStickProfile
          ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
          (reference : Measure X) (Real.log coefficient) =
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity reference ratio coefficient) := by
    simpa [Real.exp_log hCoefficient] using hforward
  rw [hforward', hreverse]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
    (realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity_nonneg reference ratio coefficient)]
  exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal hreal

/-- Epsilon-facing reverse duality. This is the form consumed by reciprocal
forward upper bounds. -/
theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_reverse_duality
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (reference : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ratio : X → Real)
    (hRatio : Measurable ratio) (hRatioNonnegative : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ ratio sample)
    (hRatioIntegrable : Integrable ratio (reference : Measure X))
    (hRatioIntegral : ∫ sample, ratio sample ∂(reference : Measure X) = 1)
    (epsilon : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile (reference : Measure X)
        ((reference : Measure X).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
        epsilon =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (1 - Real.exp epsilon + Real.exp epsilon *
          (eventHockeyStickProfile
            ((reference : Measure X).withDensity
              (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
            (reference : Measure X) (-epsilon)).toReal) := by
  let reciprocalCoefficient : Real := Real.exp (-epsilon)
  have hreciprocalPositive : 0 < reciprocalCoefficient := by
    dsimp [reciprocalCoefficient]
    positivity
  have hreverse := eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_reverse_eq_ofReal_realProfile
    reference ratio hRatio hRatioNonnegative hRatioIntegrable hreciprocalPositive
  have hreverse' :
      eventHockeyStickProfile (reference : Measure X)
          ((reference : Measure X).withDensity
            (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample))) epsilon =
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity reference ratio
            reciprocalCoefficient) := by
    simpa [reciprocalCoefficient] using hreverse
  have hforward := eventHockeyStickProfile_withDensity_forward_eq_ofReal_realProfile
    reference ratio hRatio hRatioNonnegative hRatioIntegrable (-epsilon)
  have hforward' :
      eventHockeyStickProfile
          ((reference : Measure X).withDensity
            (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (ratio sample)))
          (reference : Measure X) (-epsilon) =
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity reference ratio reciprocalCoefficient) := by
    simpa [reciprocalCoefficient] using hforward
  have hreal := realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity_coefficient_duality reference ratio
    hRatioIntegrable hRatioIntegral hreciprocalPositive
  have hreciprocal : reciprocalCoefficient = (Real.exp epsilon)⁻¹ := by
    simp [reciprocalCoefficient, Real.exp_neg]
  have hsolve :
      realHockeyStickReverseProfileWithDensity reference ratio reciprocalCoefficient =
        1 - Real.exp epsilon + Real.exp epsilon *
          realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity reference ratio reciprocalCoefficient := by
    rw [hreciprocal] at hreal ⊢
    have hexpNe : Real.exp epsilon ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos epsilon)
    field_simp [hexpNe] at hreal ⊢
    linarith
  rw [hreverse', hforward',
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
      (realHockeyStickProfileWithDensity_nonneg reference ratio reciprocalCoefficient)]
  exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal hsolve

end

end Mf.DP
import Mf.DP.FullBatchGaussianAccounting
import Mf.DP.SampledGaussianProductNoiseMonotonicity

/-!
# Threshold lemmas for sampled Gaussian calibration

This module supplies the order-theoretic API for the calibrated standard-deviation
infimum and the fixed-factor Gaussian comparison points used by the asymptotic
bracketing argument.  It makes no sampled-profile continuity or attainment claim.
-/

open Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

/-- Exact profile of the matched Gaussian source against the unchanged reference. -/
def matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (sensitivity : Real)
    (noiseStddev : NNReal) (epsilon : Real) : ENNReal :=
  binaryAccountingProfile
    (matchedGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate sensitivity (noiseStddev ^ 2))
    (sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon (noiseStddev ^ 2)) epsilon

/-- The matched product profile is the scalar Gaussian profile with signal `q Δ √T`. -/
theorem matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev_eq_scalar
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (sensitivity : Real)
    (noiseStddev : NNReal) (epsilon : Real)
    (horizon_pos : 0 < horizon) (rate_pos : 0 < samplingRate)
    (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity) (noise_pos : 0 < noiseStddev) :
    matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate sensitivity
        noiseStddev epsilon =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile
        ((samplingRate : Real) * fullBatchGaussianSignal horizon sensitivity)
        epsilon noiseStddev) := by
  unfold matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev matchedGaussianSourceProductLaw
    matchedGaussianOneStepSourceLaw sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw
  change binaryAccountingProfile
      ⟨bsrGaussianMeasure (noiseStddev : Real)
        (fun _ : Fin horizon => (samplingRate : Real) * sensitivity), by infer_instance⟩
      ⟨bsrGaussianMeasure (noiseStddev : Real)
        (fun _ : Fin horizon => 0), by infer_instance⟩ epsilon = _
  rw [bsrConstantGaussianBinaryProfile_eq_scalar horizon
    ((samplingRate : Real) * sensitivity) noiseStddev epsilon horizon_pos
    (mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast rate_pos) sensitivity_pos) (by exact_mod_cast noise_pos)]
  simp only [fullBatchGaussianSignal]
  ring_nf

/-- Feasible standard deviations remain feasible when the noise is increased. -/
theorem sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet_upward_closed
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) {small large : NNReal}
    (hsmall : small ∈ sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta) (hStddev : small ≤ large) :
    large ∈ sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta := by
  exact (sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev_antitone horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon hStddev).trans hsmall

/-- Every feasible candidate is an upper bound on the calibrated infimum. -/
theorem sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev_le_of_feasible
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) (candidate : NNReal)
    (hCandidate : candidate ∈ sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta) :
    sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity epsilon delta ≤
      candidate := by
  apply csInf_le
  · exact ⟨0, fun _ _ => bot_le⟩
  · exact hCandidate

/-- An infeasible candidate lies below the calibrated infimum once feasibility is nonempty. -/
theorem le_sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev_of_not_feasible
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) (candidate : NNReal)
    (hNonempty : (sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta).Nonempty)
    (hCandidate : candidate ∉ sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta) :
    candidate ≤ sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
      sensitivity epsilon delta := by
  unfold sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev
  apply le_csInf hNonempty
  intro feasible hFeasible
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : feasible < candidate := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  exact hCandidate (sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet_upward_closed horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon delta hFeasible hlt.le)

/-- Lower fixed-factor candidate `(1-η) q g_T`, in standard-deviation units. -/
def sampledGaussianLowerCalibrationCandidate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate eta : NNReal)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real)
    (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity) (epsilon_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (delta_pos : 0 < delta) (delta_lt_one : delta < 1) : NNReal :=
  (1 - eta) * samplingRate *
    fullBatchGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon sensitivity epsilon delta
      sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one

/-- Upper fixed-factor candidate `(1+η) q g_T`, in standard-deviation units. -/
def sampledGaussianUpperCalibrationCandidate
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate eta : NNReal)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real)
    (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity) (epsilon_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (delta_pos : 0 < delta) (delta_lt_one : delta < 1) : NNReal :=
  (1 + eta) * samplingRate *
    fullBatchGaussianCalibratedStddev horizon sensitivity epsilon delta
      sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one

/-- Reducing a positive calibrated Gaussian scale by a factor `1-η` creates a fixed gap
above the target profile. -/
theorem scalarGaussianProfile_lowerCandidate_strictGap
    {signal epsilon delta eta kappa : Real}
    (signal_pos : 0 < signal) (eta_pos : 0 < eta) (eta_lt_one : eta < 1)
    (kappa_pos : 0 < kappa)
    (kappa_spec : Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile signal epsilon kappa = delta) :
    delta < Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile signal epsilon ((1 - eta) * kappa) := by
  have hScaled : 0 < (1 - eta) * kappa := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr eta_lt_one) kappa_pos
  have hLess : (1 - eta) * kappa < kappa := by nlinarith
  have hStrict := Training.strictAntiOn_scalarGaussianSigmaProfile_pos
    signal_pos epsilon hScaled kappa_pos hLess
  simpa [kappa_spec] using hStrict

/-- Increasing a positive calibrated Gaussian scale by a factor `1+η` creates a fixed gap
below the target profile. -/
theorem scalarGaussianProfile_upperCandidate_strictGap
    {signal epsilon delta eta kappa : Real}
    (signal_pos : 0 < signal) (eta_pos : 0 < eta) (kappa_pos : 0 < kappa)
    (kappa_spec : Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile signal epsilon kappa = delta) :
    Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile signal epsilon ((1 + eta) * kappa) < delta := by
  have hScaled : 0 < (1 + eta) * kappa := mul_pos (by linarith) kappa_pos
  have hLess : kappa < (1 + eta) * kappa := by nlinarith
  have hStrict := Training.strictAntiOn_scalarGaussianSigmaProfile_pos
    signal_pos epsilon kappa_pos hScaled hLess
  simpa [kappa_spec] using hStrict

/-- The lower matched-Gaussian candidate has a horizon-independent scalar profile. -/
theorem matchedGaussianProductProfile_lowerCandidate_eq_fixed
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate eta : NNReal)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real)
    (horizon_pos : 0 < horizon) (rate_pos : 0 < samplingRate)
    (eta_lt_one : eta < 1) (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity)
    (epsilon_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilon) (delta_pos : 0 < delta)
    (delta_lt_one : delta < 1) :
    matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate sensitivity
        (sampledGaussianLowerCalibrationCandidate horizon samplingRate eta
          sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one)
        epsilon =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile sensitivity epsilon
        ((1 - (eta : Real)) * fullBatchGaussianBaseStddev sensitivity epsilon delta
          sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one)) := by
  let base := fullBatchGaussianBaseStddev sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos
    epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one
  have hbase : 0 < base :=
    (Training.scalarGaussianOptimalSigma_spec sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg
      delta_pos delta_lt_one).1
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (horizon : Real) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast horizon_pos)
  have hetaReal : (eta : Real) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast eta_lt_one
  have hnoise : 0 < sampledGaussianLowerCalibrationCandidate horizon samplingRate eta
      sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one := by
    apply mul_pos
    · exact mul_pos (tsub_pos_iff_lt.mpr eta_lt_one) rate_pos
    · exact_mod_cast mul_pos hbase hsqrt
  rw [matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev_eq_scalar horizon samplingRate sensitivity _
    epsilon horizon_pos rate_pos sensitivity_pos hnoise]
  apply congrArg ENNReal.ofReal
  unfold Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile
  apply congrArg (fun ratio => gdpProfile ratio epsilon)
  simp only [sampledGaussianLowerCalibrationCandidate,
    fullBatchGaussianCalibratedStddev_coe, NNReal.coe_mul,
    NNReal.coe_sub eta_lt_one.le]
  simp only [fullBatchGaussianSignal]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (by exact_mod_cast rate_pos : (0 : Real) < samplingRate),
    ne_of_gt hsqrt, ne_of_gt hbase, ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hetaReal)]
  <;> norm_num <;> ring

/-- The upper matched-Gaussian candidate has a horizon-independent scalar profile. -/
theorem matchedGaussianProductProfile_upperCandidate_eq_fixed
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate eta : NNReal)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real)
    (horizon_pos : 0 < horizon) (rate_pos : 0 < samplingRate)
    (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity) (epsilon_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (delta_pos : 0 < delta) (delta_lt_one : delta < 1) :
    matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate sensitivity
        (sampledGaussianUpperCalibrationCandidate horizon samplingRate eta
          sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one)
        epsilon =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile sensitivity epsilon
        ((1 + (eta : Real)) * fullBatchGaussianBaseStddev sensitivity epsilon delta
          sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one)) := by
  let base := fullBatchGaussianBaseStddev sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos
    epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one
  have hbase : 0 < base :=
    (Training.scalarGaussianOptimalSigma_spec sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg
      delta_pos delta_lt_one).1
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (horizon : Real) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast horizon_pos)
  have hnoise : 0 < sampledGaussianUpperCalibrationCandidate horizon samplingRate eta
      sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one := by
    apply mul_pos
    · exact mul_pos (by positivity) rate_pos
    · exact_mod_cast mul_pos hbase hsqrt
  rw [matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev_eq_scalar horizon samplingRate sensitivity _
    epsilon horizon_pos rate_pos sensitivity_pos hnoise]
  apply congrArg ENNReal.ofReal
  unfold Training.scalarGaussianSigmaProfile
  apply congrArg (fun ratio => gdpProfile ratio epsilon)
  simp only [sampledGaussianUpperCalibrationCandidate,
    fullBatchGaussianCalibratedStddev_coe, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_add]
  simp only [fullBatchGaussianSignal]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (by exact_mod_cast rate_pos : (0 : Real) < samplingRate),
    ne_of_gt hsqrt, ne_of_gt hbase]
  <;> norm_num

/-- The lower matched candidate is separated from the target by a strict fixed gap. -/
theorem matchedGaussianProductProfile_lowerCandidate_gt_delta
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate eta : NNReal)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real)
    (horizon_pos : 0 < horizon) (rate_pos : 0 < samplingRate)
    (eta_pos : 0 < eta) (eta_lt_one : eta < 1)
    (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity) (epsilon_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (delta_pos : 0 < delta) (delta_lt_one : delta < 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal delta <
      matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate sensitivity
        (sampledGaussianLowerCalibrationCandidate horizon samplingRate eta
          sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one)
        epsilon := by
  rw [matchedGaussianProductProfile_lowerCandidate_eq_fixed horizon samplingRate eta
    sensitivity epsilon delta horizon_pos rate_pos eta_lt_one sensitivity_pos
    epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one]
  let base := fullBatchGaussianBaseStddev sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos
    epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one
  have hspec := Training.scalarGaussianOptimalSigma_spec sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg
    delta_pos delta_lt_one
  have hgap := scalarGaussianProfile_lowerCandidate_strictGap sensitivity_pos
    (by exact_mod_cast eta_pos) (by exact_mod_cast eta_lt_one) hspec.1 hspec.2
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (delta_pos.trans hgap)).2 hgap

/-- The upper matched candidate is separated from the target by a strict fixed gap. -/
theorem matchedGaussianProductProfile_upperCandidate_lt_delta
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate eta : NNReal)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real)
    (horizon_pos : 0 < horizon) (rate_pos : 0 < samplingRate)
    (eta_pos : 0 < eta) (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity)
    (epsilon_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilon) (delta_pos : 0 < delta)
    (delta_lt_one : delta < 1) :
    matchedGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate sensitivity
        (sampledGaussianUpperCalibrationCandidate horizon samplingRate eta
          sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one)
        epsilon < ENNReal.ofReal delta := by
  rw [matchedGaussianProductProfile_upperCandidate_eq_fixed horizon samplingRate eta
    sensitivity epsilon delta horizon_pos rate_pos sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg
    delta_pos delta_lt_one]
  have hspec := Training.scalarGaussianOptimalSigma_spec sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg
    delta_pos delta_lt_one
  have hgap := scalarGaussianProfile_upperCandidate_strictGap sensitivity_pos
    (by exact_mod_cast eta_pos) hspec.1 hspec.2
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff delta_pos).2 hgap

end

end Mf.DP

import Mf.DP.FiniteProfileEventLowerBound
import Mf.DP.SampledGaussianProductMaximumEvent

/-!
# Maximum-event lower witnesses for sparse Gaussian products

The maximum-coordinate event is a certified lower witness for the forward
hockey-stick profile.  This owner deliberately does not optimize the
threshold and does not claim that the event is profile-optimal.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- The real-valued maximum-event witness used by numerical certificates. -/
def sparseGaussianProductMaximumEventForwardLowerBoundReal
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : Real :=
  let p : Real :=
    (1 - (samplingRate : Real)) * stdNormalCDFReal threshold +
      (samplingRate : Real) *
        stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - standardizedShift)
  1 - p ^ horizon - Real.exp epsilon *
    (1 - (stdNormalCDFReal threshold) ^ horizon)

def sparseGaussianProductMaximumEventForwardLowerBound
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) : ENNReal :=
  1 -
      ((1 - (samplingRate : ENNReal)) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (stdNormalCDFReal threshold) +
        (samplingRate : ENNReal) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - standardizedShift))) ^ horizon -
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp epsilon) *
      (1 - (ENNReal.ofReal (stdNormalCDFReal threshold)) ^ horizon)

/-- The nonnegative witness is exactly the positive part of its real formula. -/
theorem ennreal_ofReal_sparseGaussianProductMaximumEventForwardLowerBoundReal
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift epsilon threshold : Real) :
    ENNReal.ofReal
        (sparseGaussianProductMaximumEventForwardLowerBoundReal
          horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift epsilon threshold) =
      sparseGaussianProductMaximumEventForwardLowerBound
        horizon samplingRate hRate standardizedShift epsilon threshold := by
  let c : Real := stdNormalCDFReal threshold
  let d : Real := stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - standardizedShift)
  let q : Real := (samplingRate : Real)
  let p : Real := (1 - q) * c + q * d
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    positivity
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact_mod_cast hRate
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := stdNormalCDFReal_nonneg _
  have hc1 : c ≤ 1 := stdNormalCDFReal_le_one _
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := stdNormalCDFReal_nonneg _
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by
    dsimp [p]
    positivity
  have hpow0 : 0 ≤ p ^ horizon := pow_nonneg hp0 _

import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.MeanInequalities

/-!
# Positive-part bounds under a finite measure

This owner bounds the integral of a positive part by the zeroth, first, and
second moments under the same finite measure.  Applying it to a restricted
measure preserves the restricted mass instead of introducing a zero-extension
penalty outside the retained event.
-/

open MeasureTheory

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- Finite-measure Cauchy--Schwarz in a form that keeps the total mass. -/
theorem integral_abs_le_sqrt_measureReal_mul_integral_sq
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (measure : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure measure]
    (value : X → Real)
    (hvalue : AEStronglyMeasurable value measure)
    (hsquare : Integrable (fun sample => value sample ^ 2) measure) :
    (∫ sample, |value sample| ∂measure) ≤
      Real.sqrt (measure.real Set.univ * ∫ sample, value sample ^ 2 ∂measure) := by
  have hone : MemLp (fun _ : X => (1 : Real)) 2 measure :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq
      stronglyMeasurable_const.aestronglyMeasurable).2 (integrable_const _)
  have habs : MemLp (fun sample => |value sample|) 2 measure :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hvalue.norm).2
      (by simpa [sq_abs] using hsquare)
  have hholder := integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg
    (μ := measure) (p := (2 : Real)) (q := (2 : Real))
    Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
    (ae_of_all measure fun _ : X => show 0 ≤ (1 : Real) by norm_num)
    (ae_of_all measure fun sample => abs_nonneg (value sample))
    (by simpa using hone) (by simpa using habs)
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul measureReal_nonneg]
  simpa [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, sq_abs] using hholder

/-- The coefficient-level positive-part second-moment bound under an arbitrary
finite measure.  The square term is centered at the supplied coefficient. -/
theorem integral_positivePart_le_of_integrable_sq
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (measure : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure measure]
    (value : X → Real) (coefficient : Real)
    (hvalue : AEStronglyMeasurable value measure)
    (hsquare : Integrable (fun sample => (value sample - coefficient) ^ 2) measure) :
    (∫ sample, max (value sample - coefficient) 0 ∂measure) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (measure.real Set.univ *
          ∫ sample, (value sample - coefficient) ^ 2 ∂measure) +
        (∫ sample, value sample ∂measure) -
          coefficient * measure.real Set.univ) / 2 := by
  let residual : X → Real := fun sample => value sample - coefficient
  have hresidual : AEStronglyMeasurable residual measure :=
    hvalue.sub stronglyMeasurable_const.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hresidualLp : MemLp residual 2 measure :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hresidual).2 hsquare
  have hresidualIntegrable : Integrable residual measure :=
    hresidualLp.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hvalueIntegrable : Integrable value measure := by
    simpa [residual, sub_eq_add_neg] using
      hresidualIntegrable.add (integrable_const coefficient)
  have habs := integral_abs_le_sqrt_measureReal_mul_integral_sq
    measure residual hresidual hsquare
  have hpoint : (fun sample => max (value sample - coefficient) 0) =
      fun sample => (|residual sample| + residual sample) / 2 := by
    funext sample
    by_cases hnonneg : 0 ≤ residual sample
    · rw [max_eq_left]
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
        ring
      · exact hnonneg
    · have hnonpos : residual sample ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hnonneg
      rw [max_eq_right hnonpos, abs_of_nonpos hnonpos]
      ring
  have habsIntegrable : Integrable (fun sample => |residual sample|) measure := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hresidualIntegrable.norm
  rw [hpoint, integral_div, integral_add habsIntegrable hresidualIntegrable]
  rw [show (∫ sample, residual sample ∂measure) =
      (∫ sample, value sample ∂measure) - coefficient * measure.real Set.univ by
    dsimp [residual]
    rw [integral_sub hvalueIntegrable (integrable_const coefficient), integral_const]
    simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]]
  have habs' : (∫ sample, |residual sample| ∂measure) ≤
      Real.sqrt (measure.real Set.univ *
        ∫ sample, (value sample - coefficient) ^ 2 ∂measure) := by
    simpa [residual] using habs
  linarith

/-- Expanding a square under a finite measure retains the total mass in the
constant term. -/
theorem integral_sub_const_sq_eq
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (measure : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure measure]
    (value : X → Real) (coefficient : Real)
    (hvalue : Integrable value measure)
    (hvalueSquare : Integrable (fun sample => value sample ^ 2) measure) :
    (∫ sample, (value sample - coefficient) ^ 2 ∂measure) =
    (∫ sample, value sample ^ 2 ∂measure) -
        2 * coefficient * (∫ sample, value sample ∂measure) +
        coefficient ^ 2 * measure.real Set.univ := by
  have hlinear : Integrable (fun sample => 2 * coefficient * value sample) measure :=
    hvalue.const_mul _
  have hconstant : Integrable (fun _ : X => coefficient ^ 2) measure :=
    integrable_const _
  rw [show (fun sample => (value sample - coefficient) ^ 2) = fun sample =>
      value sample ^ 2 - 2 * coefficient * value sample + coefficient ^ 2 by
    funext sample
    ring]
  change (∫ sample,
      ((fun x => value x ^ 2) - (fun x => 2 * coefficient * value x)) sample +
        (fun _ : X => coefficient ^ 2) sample ∂measure) = _
  rw [integral_add (hvalueSquare.sub hlinear) hconstant]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [integral_sub hvalueSquare hlinear, integral_const_mul, integral_const]
  simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

/-- The centered square integral is nonnegative. -/
theorem integral_sub_const_sq_nonneg
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (measure : Measure X) (value : X → Real) (coefficient : Real) :
    0 ≤ ∫ sample, (value sample - coefficient) ^ 2 ∂measure :=
  integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _

end

end Mf.DP
