import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.Pi

/-!
# Product sampled-Gaussian noise monotonicity

Larger coordinatewise Gaussian variance is realized by adding one independent
residual Gaussian vector to both neighboring product laws.  Common randomized
postprocessing therefore makes the exact binary profile antitone in variance
and in the public standard-deviation parameter.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

/-- Independent centered Gaussian coordinates with a common variance. -/
def centeredGaussianProductLaw (horizon : Nat) (variance : NNReal) :
    ProbabilityMeasure (Fin horizon → Real) :=
  ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ => ⟨gaussianReal 0 variance, by infer_instance⟩)

/-- Add two finite real vectors coordinatewise. -/
def coordinatewiseAdd (horizon : Nat) :
    (Fin horizon → Real) × (Fin horizon → Real) → (Fin horizon → Real) :=
  fun pair coordinate => pair.1 coordinate + pair.2 coordinate

theorem measurable_coordinatewiseAdd (horizon : Nat) :
    Measurable (coordinatewiseAdd horizon) := by
  unfold coordinatewiseAdd
  fun_prop

/-- Reassociate two finite product measures and apply the same map coordinatewise. -/
theorem map_productMeasures_coordinatewise
    {ι X Z Y : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (f : X × Z → Y) (hf : Measurable f)
    (mu : ι → Measure X) (rho : ι → Measure Z)
    [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (mu i)] [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (rho i)]
    [∀ i, SigmaFinite (mu i)] [∀ i, SigmaFinite (rho i)] :
    Measure.map (fun pair : (ι → X) × (ι → Z) =>
        fun i => f (pair.1 i, pair.2 i))
        ((Measure.pi mu).prod (Measure.pi rho)) =
      Measure.pi (fun i => Measure.map f ((mu i).prod (rho i))) := by
  let e : (ι → X × Z) ≃ᵐ (ι → X) × (ι → Z) :=
    MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow X Z ι
  have he : Measure.map e (Measure.pi (fun i => (mu i).prod (rho i))) =
      (Measure.pi mu).prod (Measure.pi rho) :=
    measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow X Z ι mu rho |>.map_eq
  rw [← he, Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) e.measurable]
  have hfun :
      (fun pair : (ι → X) × (ι → Z) => fun i => f (pair.1 i, pair.2 i)) ∘ e =
        (fun sample : ι → X × Z => fun i => f (sample i)) := by
    funext sample i
    rfl
  rw [hfun, Measure.pi_map_pi (fun _ => hf.aemeasurable)]

/-- Adding a residual Gaussian vector realizes the larger-variance sampled source product. -/
theorem sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw_add_residual
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity : Real) (small large residual : NNReal)
    (hvariance : large = small + residual) :
    Measure.map (coordinatewiseAdd horizon)
      ((sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity small).prod
        (centeredGaussianProductLaw horizon residual) :
        Measure ((Fin horizon → Real) × (Fin horizon → Real))) =
      (sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity large :
        Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) := by
  let mu : Fin horizon → Measure Real := fun _ =>
    (sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw samplingRate hRate sensitivity small : Measure Real)
  let rho : Fin horizon → Measure Real := fun _ => gaussianReal 0 residual
  change Measure.map (coordinatewiseAdd horizon)
      ((Measure.pi mu).prod (Measure.pi rho)) = _
  unfold coordinatewiseAdd
  rw [map_productMeasures_coordinatewise
    (fun pair : Real × Real => pair.1 + pair.2)
    (measurable_fst.add measurable_snd) mu rho]
  congr 1
  funext coordinate
  change (sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw samplingRate hRate sensitivity small :
      Measure Real) ∗ gaussianReal 0 residual = _
  simp [sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw, gaussianNoiseLaw, hvariance,
    Measure.conv_assoc, gaussianReal_conv_gaussianReal]

/-- Adding the same residual vector realizes the larger-variance reference product. -/
theorem sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw_add_residual
    (horizon : Nat) (small large residual : NNReal)
    (hvariance : large = small + residual) :
    Measure.map (coordinatewiseAdd horizon)
      ((sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon small).prod
        (centeredGaussianProductLaw horizon residual) :
        Measure ((Fin horizon → Real) × (Fin horizon → Real))) =
      (sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon large :
        Measure (Fin horizon → Real)) := by
  simpa [sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw, sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw,
    sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw_zeroSamplingRate] using
    (sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw_add_residual horizon 0 (by norm_num) 0
      small large residual hvariance)

/-- The exact sampled product profile is antitone in per-coordinate variance. -/
theorem sampledGaussianProductProfile_variance_antitone
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon : Real) {small large : NNReal} (hvariance : small ≤ large) :
    binaryAccountingProfile
        (sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity large)
        (sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon large) epsilon ≤
      binaryAccountingProfile
        (sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity small)
        (sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon small) epsilon := by
  let residual : NNReal := large - small
  have hsum : large = small + residual := (add_tsub_cancel_of_le hvariance).symm
  have hcontract := binaryAccountingProfile_common_randomized_map_le
    (coordinatewiseAdd horizon) (measurable_coordinatewiseAdd horizon)
    (sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity small)
    (sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon small)
    (centeredGaussianProductLaw horizon residual) epsilon
  have hsource :
      ((sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity small).prod
          (centeredGaussianProductLaw horizon residual)).map
            (measurable_coordinatewiseAdd horizon).aemeasurable =
        sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity large := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw_add_residual horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity
      small large residual hsum
  have hreference :
      ((sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon small).prod
          (centeredGaussianProductLaw horizon residual)).map
            (measurable_coordinatewiseAdd horizon).aemeasurable =
        sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon large := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw_add_residual horizon small large residual hsum
  rw [hsource, hreference] at hcontract
  exact hcontract

/-- The public standard-deviation profile is antitone in noise standard deviation. -/
theorem sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev_antitone
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon : Real) {small large : NNReal} (hStddev : small ≤ large) :
    sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity large epsilon ≤
      sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity small epsilon := by
  unfold sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev
  exact sampledGaussianProductProfile_variance_antitone horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon (pow_le_pow_left' hStddev 2)

end

end Mf.DP

/-!
# Calibrated standard deviation for sampled Gaussian products

Calibration is exposed in standard-deviation units.  The underlying law
constructors continue to receive variance, so the wrapper passes the square of
the public parameter.  The infimum is total and makes no finite-horizon
attainment or positivity claim.
-/

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

/-- Exact sampled-Gaussian product profile parameterized by noise standard deviation. -/
def sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity : Real) (noiseStddev : NNReal) (epsilon : Real) : ENNReal :=
  binaryAccountingProfile
    (sampledGaussianSourceProductLaw horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity
      (noiseStddev ^ 2))
    (sampledGaussianReferenceProductLaw horizon (noiseStddev ^ 2)) epsilon

/-- Corrected public domain for sampled-Gaussian calibration. -/
def SampledGaussianCalibrationAdmissible
    (samplingRate : NNReal) (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) : Prop :=
  0 < samplingRate ∧ samplingRate ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < sensitivity ∧
    0 ≤ epsilon ∧ 0 < delta ∧ delta < 1

/-- Standard deviations whose exact product accounting profile meets the target slack. -/
def sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) : Set NNReal :=
  {noiseStddev | sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity noiseStddev epsilon ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta}

@[simp] theorem mem_sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet_iff
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) (noiseStddev : NNReal) :
    noiseStddev ∈ sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
        sensitivity epsilon delta ↔
      sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon samplingRate hRate sensitivity
        noiseStddev epsilon ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Nonnegative infimum of feasible sampled-Gaussian noise standard deviations. -/
def sampledGaussianCalibratedStddev
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity epsilon delta : Real) : NNReal :=
  sInf (sampledGaussianFeasibleStddevSet horizon samplingRate hRate
    sensitivity epsilon delta)

end

end Mf.DP

namespace Mf
namespace DP
namespace Training

/-- A user-level dataset is a finite set of user records. -/
abbrev UserDataset (Record : Type*) [DecidableEq Record] := Finset Record

/-- Symmetric user add/remove adjacency used by the mathematical training mechanisms. -/
def UserAddRemoveAdj
    {Record : Type*} [DecidableEq Record] :
    UserDataset Record → UserDataset Record → Prop :=
  FinsetAddRemoveAdjacent

theorem userAddRemoveAdj_symm
    {Record : Type*} [DecidableEq Record]
    {left right : UserDataset Record}
    (h : UserAddRemoveAdj left right) :
    UserAddRemoveAdj right left :=
  finsetAddRemoveAdjacent_symm h

/-- User replace-one adjacency through a shared dataset.  Distinct absent
records are removed and added, so this relation excludes the diagonal. -/
def UserReplaceOneAdj
    {Record : Type*} [DecidableEq Record]
    (left right : UserDataset Record) : Prop :=
  ∃ common removed added,
    removed ∉ common ∧
    added ∉ common ∧
    removed ≠ added ∧
    left = insert removed common ∧
    right = insert added common

theorem userReplaceOneAdj_symm
    {Record : Type*} [DecidableEq Record]
    {left right : UserDataset Record}
    (h : UserReplaceOneAdj left right) :
    UserReplaceOneAdj right left := by
  rcases h with ⟨common, removed, added, hremoved, hadded, hne, hleft, hright⟩
  exact ⟨common, added, removed, hadded, hremoved, hne.symm, hright, hleft⟩

theorem userReplaceOneAdj_card_eq
    {Record : Type*} [DecidableEq Record]
    {left right : UserDataset Record}
    (h : UserReplaceOneAdj left right) :
    left.card = right.card := by
  rcases h with ⟨common, removed, added, hremoved, hadded, _, rfl, rfl⟩
  simp [hremoved, hadded]

theorem userReplaceOneAdj_ne
    {Record : Type*} [DecidableEq Record]
    {left right : UserDataset Record}
    (h : UserReplaceOneAdj left right) :
    left ≠ right := by
  rcases h with ⟨common, removed, added, hremoved, hadded, hne, rfl, rfl⟩
  intro heq
  have hmem : removed ∈ insert added common := by
    rw [← heq]
    simp
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hmem with heq' | hmem'
  · exact hne heq'
  · exact hremoved hmem'

/-- Every replacement is an ordered removal followed by an insertion through
the common dataset supplied by the replacement witness. -/
theorem userReplaceOneAdj_addRemove_hops
    {Record : Type*} [DecidableEq Record]
    {left right : UserDataset Record}
    (h : UserReplaceOneAdj left right) :
    ∃ middle,
      UserAddRemoveAdj left middle ∧
      UserAddRemoveAdj middle right := by
  rcases h with ⟨common, removed, added, hremoved, hadded, _, hleft, hright⟩
  refine ⟨common, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨removed, hremoved, hleft⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨added, hadded, hright⟩

/-!
# Exact law-level binary accounting

This module defines the paper-facing binary accounting profile directly as a
supremum over measurable events.  It proves that profile thresholds are
exactly the two ordered approximate-DP law inequalities, and records the
measurable-bijection and event-distance transport facts used later in the
paper.  No numerical accountant or divergence upper bound is involved.
-/

open MeasureTheory Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

/-- The exact ordered hockey-stick profile of two laws, expressed in `ENNReal`. -/
def eventHockeyStickProfile
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (mu nu : Measure Y) (epsilon : Real) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ s : {s : Set Y // MeasurableSet s},
    mu s.1 - ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp epsilon) * nu s.1

/-- An ordered event inequality with an `ENNReal` coefficient and slack. -/
def OrderedENNRealLawPair
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (mu nu : Measure Y) (coefficient slack : ENNReal) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → mu s ≤ coefficient * nu s + slack

/-- The event supremum has the expected threshold characterization in `ENNReal`. -/
theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_le_iff_orderedENNRealLawPair
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (mu nu : Measure Y) (epsilon : Real) (slack : ENNReal) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile mu nu epsilon ≤ slack ↔
      OrderedENNRealLawPair mu nu (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp epsilon)) slack := by
  rw [eventHockeyStickProfile, iSup_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h s hs
    have h' := h ⟨s, hs⟩
    rw [tsub_le_iff_right] at h'
    simpa [add_comm] using h'
  · intro h s
    rw [tsub_le_iff_right]
    simpa [OrderedENNRealLawPair, add_comm] using h s.1 s.2

/-- Thresholding the event supremum is exactly the ordered approximate-DP law inequality. -/
theorem eventHockeyStickProfile_le_iff_orderedApproxDPLawPair
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (mu nu : ProbabilityMeasure Y) (epsilon delta : Real) :
    eventHockeyStickProfile (mu : Measure Y) (nu : Measure Y) epsilon ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal delta ↔
      OrderedApproxDPLawPair mu nu epsilon delta := by
  rw [eventHockeyStickProfile, iSup_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h s hs
    have h' := h ⟨s, hs⟩
    rw [tsub_le_iff_right] at h'
    simpa [add_comm] using h'
  · intro h s
    rw [tsub_le_iff_right]
    simpa [add_comm] using h s.1 s.2

/-- Exact two-sided accounting oracle for a binary pair of probability laws. -/
def binaryAccountingProfile
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (mu nu : ProbabilityMeasure Y) (epsilon : Real) : ENNReal :=
  max
    (eventHockeyStickProfile (mu : Measure Y) (nu : Measure Y) epsilon)
    (eventHockeyStickProfile (nu : Measure Y) (mu : Measure Y) epsilon)

/-- A law compared with itself has zero profile at nonnegative privacy budget. -/
theorem binaryAccountingProfile_self_eq_zero
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] (mu : ProbabilityMeasure Y)
    (epsilon : Real) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) :
    binaryAccountingProfile mu mu epsilon = 0 := by
  have hordered : OrderedENNRealLawPair (mu : Measure Y) (mu : Measure Y)
      (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp epsilon)) 0 := by
    intro s hs
    simp only [add_zero]
    have hcoefficient : 1 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp epsilon) := by
      simpa using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.one_le_exp hepsilon)
    calc
      (mu : Measure Y) s = 1 * (mu : Measure Y) s := by simp
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp epsilon) * (mu : Measure Y) s :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient (by exact bot_le)
  have hprofile : eventHockeyStickProfile (mu : Measure Y) (mu : Measure Y)
      epsilon = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact
        (eventHockeyStickProfile_le_iff_orderedENNRealLawPair _ _ _ _).2 hordered
    · exact bot_le
  simp [binaryAccountingProfile, hprofile]

/-- A binary profile threshold is exactly the pair of ordered event inequalities. -/
theorem binaryAccountingProfile_le_iff
    {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (mu nu : ProbabilityMeasure Y) (epsilon delta : Real) :
    binaryAccountingProfile mu nu epsilon ≤ ENNReal.ofReal delta ↔

        OrderedApproxDPLawPair nu mu epsilon delta := by
  simp only [binaryAccountingProfile, max_le_iff,

/--
Uniform theorem-facing mass on the fixed-cardinality BIS support.

The mass is intentionally defined on all subsets, but is nonzero only on
`base.powersetCard k`.
-/
def bisFixedCardUniformMass {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (base : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (u : Finset α) : ℝ :=
  if u ∈ base.powersetCard k then ((Nat.choose base.card k : ℝ)⁻¹) else 0

/-- Coordinate marginal induced by the uniform fixed-cardinality BIS mass. -/
def bisFixedCardUniformMarginal {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (base : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (a : α) : ℝ :=
  Finset.sum (base.powersetCard k)
    (fun u : Finset α =>
      bisFixedCardUniformMass base k u * if a ∈ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

/-- Joint coordinate marginal induced by the uniform fixed-cardinality BIS mass. -/
def bisFixedCardUniformPairMarginal {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (base : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (a b : α) : ℝ :=
  Finset.sum (base.powersetCard k)
    (fun u : Finset α =>
      bisFixedCardUniformMass base k u * if a ∈ u ∧ b ∈ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

/-- Covariance entry induced by the uniform fixed-cardinality BIS mass. -/
def bisFixedCardUniformCovarianceEntry {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (base : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (a b : α) : ℝ :=
  bisFixedCardUniformPairMarginal base k a b
    - bisFixedCardUniformMarginal base k a * bisFixedCardUniformMarginal base k b

/-- Uniform fixed-cardinality mass is nonnegative. -/
theorem bisFixedCardUniformMass_nonneg
    {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (base : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (u : Finset α) :
    0 ≤ bisFixedCardUniformMass base k u := by
  unfold bisFixedCardUniformMass
  by_cases h : u ∈ base.powersetCard k
  · simp [h, inv_nonneg]
  · simp [h]

/-- Uniform fixed-cardinality mass normalizes on its support. -/
theorem bisFixedCardUniformMass_sum_support_eq_one
    {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (base : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ base.card) :
    Finset.sum (base.powersetCard k) (bisFixedCardUniformMass base k) = 1 := by
  unfold bisFixedCardUniformMass
  have hchoose_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.choose base.card k : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos hk
  calc
    Finset.sum (base.powersetCard k)
        (fun u => if u ∈ base.powersetCard k then ((Nat.choose base.card k : ℝ)⁻¹) else 0)

    _ = 1 := by

/-- Uniform fixed-cardinality mass normalizes as a full finite-type sum. -/
theorem bisFixedCardUniformMass_sum_univ_eq_one
    {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (base : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ base.card) :
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (bisFixedCardUniformMass base k) = 1 := by

    Finset.sum Finset.univ (bisFixedCardUniformMass base k)

    integral_gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare_Iic]

theorem integral_sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio_belowBox
    (horizon : Nat) (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift threshold : Real) :
    (∫ sample in sparseGaussianProductBelowBox horizon threshold,
      sparseGaussianProductLikelihoodRatio horizon (samplingRate : Real)
        standardizedShift sample
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin horizon => gaussianReal 0 1)) =
      ((1 - (samplingRate : Real)) * stdNormalCDFReal threshold +
        (samplingRate : Real) *
          stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - standardizedShift)) ^ horizon := by
  change (∫ sample in Set.pi Set.univ (fun _ : Fin horizon => Set.Iic threshold),

        standardizedShift sample

/-!
# Truncated Gaussian exponential moments

This module proves the two exact exponential-tilting identities used by sparse
Gaussian likelihood analysis.  The tilt and threshold are arbitrary real
numbers, and truncation is the closed event `sample ≤ threshold`.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

/-- Pointwise Gaussian completion of squares for exponential tilting. -/
theorem standardGaussianPDF_mul_likelihoodTilt
    (tilt sample : Real) :
    gaussianPDFReal 0 (1 : NNReal) sample *
        Real.exp (tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2 / 2) =
      gaussianPDFReal tilt (1 : NNReal) sample := by
  rw [gaussianPDFReal_def, gaussianPDFReal_def]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  norm_num
  field_simp
  ring

/-- A Gaussian likelihood tilt is integrable under the standard Gaussian. -/
theorem integrable_gaussianLikelihoodTilt (tilt : Real) :
    Integrable (fun sample : Real =>
      Real.exp (tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2 / 2))
      (gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)) := by
  have h := ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal
    (μ := (0 : Real)) (v := (1 : NNReal)) tilt
  convert h.const_mul (Real.exp (-(tilt ^ 2 / 2))) using 1
  funext sample
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

theorem integrableOn_gaussianLikelihoodTilt_Iic
    (tilt threshold : Real) :
    IntegrableOn (fun sample : Real =>
      Real.exp (tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2 / 2))
      (Iic threshold) (gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)) :=
  (integrable_gaussianLikelihoodTilt tilt).integrableOn

private theorem integral_gaussianLikelihoodTilt_Iic_eq_shiftedGaussian
    (tilt threshold : Real) :
    (∫ sample in Iic threshold,
      Real.exp (tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2 / 2)
      ∂gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)) =
      (gaussianReal tilt (1 : NNReal)).real (Iic threshold) := by
  let reference : Measure Real := gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)
  let shifted : Measure Real := gaussianReal tilt (1 : NNReal)
  let density : Real → ENNReal := fun sample =>
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2 / 2))
  let event : Set Real := Iic threshold
  have hEvent : MeasurableSet event := measurableSet_Iic
  have hDensity : Measurable density := Measurable.ennreal_ofReal (by fun_prop)
  have hMeasure : shifted = reference.withDensity density := by
    rw [show shifted = volume.withDensity (gaussianPDF tilt (1 : NNReal)) by
      simp [shifted, gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero, one_ne_zero]]
    rw [show reference = volume.withDensity (gaussianPDF 0 (1 : NNReal)) by
      simp [reference, gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero, one_ne_zero]]
    rw [← withDensity_mul volume (measurable_gaussianPDF 0 (1 : NNReal))]
    · congr 1
      funext sample
      unfold gaussianPDF
      rw [Pi.mul_apply, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 sample)]
      congr 1
      exact (standardGaussianPDF_mul_likelihoodTilt tilt sample).symm
    · exact hDensity
  calc
    (∫ sample in event, Real.exp (tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2 / 2) ∂reference) =
        ∫ sample, event.indicator (fun value =>
          Real.exp (tilt * value - tilt ^ 2 / 2)) sample ∂reference := by
      rw [integral_indicator hEvent]
    _ = ∫ sample, event.indicator (fun _ => (1 : Real)) sample
          ∂(reference.withDensity density) := by
      rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hDensity]
      · apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with sample
        by_cases hmem : sample ∈ event
        · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
          rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.exp_pos _).le]
          simp [smul_eq_mul]
        · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem]
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun sample => by simp [density]
    _ = ∫ sample, event.indicator (fun _ => (1 : Real)) sample ∂shifted := by
      rw [← hMeasure]
    _ = shifted.real event := by
      rw [integral_indicator hEvent]
      simp [Measure.real]

/-- First exact truncated exponential moment. -/
theorem integral_gaussianLikelihoodTilt_Iic
    (tilt threshold : Real) :
    (∫ sample in Iic threshold,
      Real.exp (tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2 / 2)
      ∂gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)) =
      stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - tilt) := by
  rw [integral_gaussianLikelihoodTilt_Iic_eq_shiftedGaussian]
  have hMeasure := gaussianReal_apply_Iic_eq_stdNormalMeasure_affine
    tilt 1 threshold (by norm_num)
  have hReal := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hMeasure
  have hv : (⟨(1 : Real) ^ 2, sq_nonneg 1⟩ : NNReal) = 1 := by
    exact Subtype.ext (by norm_num)
  rw [hv] at hReal
  norm_num at hReal
  rw [stdNormalCDFReal_eq_real_measure_Iic]
  change ((gaussianReal tilt (1 : NNReal)) (Iic threshold)).toReal =
    (stdNormalMeasure (Iic (threshold - tilt))).toReal
  exact hReal

theorem gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare_reduction
    (tilt sample : Real) :
    Real.exp (2 * tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2) =
      Real.exp (tilt ^ 2) *
        Real.exp ((2 * tilt) * sample - (2 * tilt) ^ 2 / 2) := by
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

theorem integrable_gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare (tilt : Real) :
    Integrable (fun sample : Real =>
      Real.exp (2 * tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2))
      (gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)) := by
  rw [show (fun sample : Real => Real.exp (2 * tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2)) =
      fun sample => Real.exp (tilt ^ 2) *
        Real.exp ((2 * tilt) * sample - (2 * tilt) ^ 2 / 2) by
    funext sample
    exact gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare_reduction tilt sample]
  exact (integrable_gaussianLikelihoodTilt (2 * tilt)).const_mul _

theorem integrableOn_gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare_Iic
    (tilt threshold : Real) :
    IntegrableOn (fun sample : Real =>
      Real.exp (2 * tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2))
      (Iic threshold) (gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)) :=
  (integrable_gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare tilt).integrableOn

/-- Second exact truncated exponential moment. -/
theorem integral_gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare_Iic
    (tilt threshold : Real) :
    (∫ sample in Iic threshold,
      Real.exp (2 * tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2)
      ∂gaussianReal 0 (1 : NNReal)) =
      Real.exp (tilt ^ 2) * stdNormalCDFReal (threshold - 2 * tilt) := by
  rw [show (fun sample : Real => Real.exp (2 * tilt * sample - tilt ^ 2)) =
      fun sample => Real.exp (tilt ^ 2) *
        Real.exp ((2 * tilt) * sample - (2 * tilt) ^ 2 / 2) by
    funext sample
    exact gaussianLikelihoodTiltSquare_reduction tilt sample]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_gaussianLikelihoodTilt_Iic]

end

end Mf.DP

import Mf.DP.GaussianApproxDP

namespace Mf
namespace DP
namespace Training

open MeasureTheory

noncomputable section

/-!
# Uniform global sigma optimality

This module owns only the family-independent meaning of a globally least
positive Gaussian scale. Domain-specific modules must still prove that their
privacy predicate has this shape. In particular, these definitions do not
turn a finite candidate minimum or an unattained infimum into an optimum.
-/

/-- Uniform privacy at one positive real noise scale for a public oracle family. -/
def UniformPrivateAt
    {Oracle Dataset Output : Type}
    [MeasurableSpace Output]
    (adj : Dataset → Dataset → Prop)
    (mechanism : Oracle → ℝ → Dataset → Measure Output)
    (epsilon delta sigma : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < sigma ∧
    ∀ oracle, ApproxDP adj (mechanism oracle sigma) epsilon delta

/--
`sigmaStar` is the attained global threshold exactly when the feasible positive
scales form the upper ray beginning at `sigmaStar`.
-/
def IsGlobalSigmaThreshold
    (privateAt : ℝ → Prop)
    (sigmaStar : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < sigmaStar ∧
    privateAt sigmaStar ∧
    ∀ sigma, 0 < sigma → (privateAt sigma ↔ sigmaStar ≤ sigma)

/-- Existence of an attained globally least positive sigma. -/
def HasGlobalSigmaThreshold (privateAt : ℝ → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ sigmaStar, IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt sigmaStar

namespace IsGlobalSigmaThreshold

theorem positive
    {privateAt : ℝ → Prop} {sigmaStar : ℝ}
    (h : IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt sigmaStar) :
    0 < sigmaStar :=
  h.1

theorem private_at
    {privateAt : ℝ → Prop} {sigmaStar : ℝ}
    (h : IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt sigmaStar) :
    privateAt sigmaStar :=
  h.2.1

theorem private_iff_le
    {privateAt : ℝ → Prop} {sigmaStar sigma : ℝ}
    (h : IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt sigmaStar)
    (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    privateAt sigma ↔ sigmaStar ≤ sigma :=
  h.2.2 sigma hsigma

theorem least_of_private
    {privateAt : ℝ → Prop} {sigmaStar sigma : ℝ}
    (h : IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt sigmaStar)
    (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hprivate : privateAt sigma) :
    sigmaStar ≤ sigma :=
  (h.private_iff_le hsigma).mp hprivate

theorem not_private_of_lt
    {privateAt : ℝ → Prop} {sigmaStar sigma : ℝ}
    (h : IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt sigmaStar)
    (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hlt : sigma < sigmaStar) :
    ¬ privateAt sigma := by
  intro hprivate
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) (h.least_of_private hsigma hprivate)

theorem unique
    {privateAt : ℝ → Prop} {left right : ℝ}
    (hleft : IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt left)
    (hright : IsGlobalSigmaThreshold privateAt right) :
    left = right := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact hleft.least_of_private hright.positive hright.private_at
  · exact hright.least_of_private hleft.positive hleft.private_at

end IsGlobalSigmaThreshold

end

end Training
end DP
end Mf
import Mf.DP.CenteredBernoulliGaussianChiSquare
import Mf.DP.MatchedGaussianSourceNormalization

/-!
# Direct sparse Gaussian likelihood ratios

This module keeps the privacy reference, rather than the matched Gaussian
source, at the origin.  Dividing a sampled Gaussian step by a positive noise
standard deviation sends the reference to `N(0,1)` and gives the sampled
source the density

`1 - q + q * exp (mu * z - mu^2 / 2)`

with respect to that standard Gaussian, where `mu` is the standardized shift.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace Mf.DP

noncomputable section

/-- Likelihood ratio of `(1-q) N(0,1) + q N(mu,1)` against `N(0,1)`. -/
def sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio
    (samplingRate standardizedShift sample : Real) : Real :=
  1 - samplingRate + samplingRate *
    Real.exp (standardizedShift * sample - standardizedShift ^ 2 / 2)

/-- The unsampled mixture mass is a pointwise likelihood-ratio floor. -/
theorem sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio_ge_one_sub_rate
    (samplingRate : NNReal) (standardizedShift sample : Real) :
    1 - (samplingRate : Real) ≤
      sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio (samplingRate : Real) standardizedShift sample := by
  unfold sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg samplingRate) (Real.exp_pos _).le)

/-- The direct, uncentered standardized Bernoulli--Gaussian mixture. -/
def sparseGaussianMixtureLaw
    (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift : Real) : ProbabilityMeasure Real := by
  let mixture : Measure Real :=
    ((1 - samplingRate : NNReal) : ENNReal) • gaussianReal 0 1 +
      (samplingRate : ENNReal) • gaussianReal standardizedShift 1
  refine ⟨mixture, ?_⟩
  constructor
  simp [mixture, ENNReal.coe_sub]
  exact tsub_add_cancel_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hRate)

theorem measurable_sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio
    (samplingRate standardizedShift : Real) :
    Measurable (sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio samplingRate standardizedShift) := by
  unfold sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio
  fun_prop

theorem sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio_pos
    (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift sample : Real) :
    0 < sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio samplingRate standardizedShift sample := by
  unfold sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio
  have hRateNonneg : 0 ≤ (samplingRate : Real) := NNReal.coe_nonneg samplingRate
  have hRateOne : (samplingRate : Real) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hRate
  by_cases hZero : (samplingRate : Real) = 0
  · simp [hZero]
  · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sub_nonneg.mpr hRateOne)
      (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne hRateNonneg (Ne.symm hZero)) (Real.exp_pos _))

theorem integrable_sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio
    (samplingRate standardizedShift : Real) :
    Integrable (sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio samplingRate standardizedShift)
      (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
  have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : Real => 1 - samplingRate) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    integrable_const _
  have hshift : Integrable
      (fun sample : Real => samplingRate *
        gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio standardizedShift sample)
    (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (integrable_gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio standardizedShift).const_mul samplingRate
  exact (hconst.add hshift).congr
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun sample => by
      unfold sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio
      change 1 - samplingRate + samplingRate *
        Real.exp (standardizedShift * sample - standardizedShift ^ 2 / 2) = _
      rfl)

/-- The direct one-step likelihood ratio has unit mass under `N(0,1)`. -/
theorem integral_sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio
    (samplingRate standardizedShift : Real) :
    (∫ sample, sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio samplingRate standardizedShift sample
      ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = 1 := by
  have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : Real => 1 - samplingRate) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    integrable_const _
  have hshift : Integrable
      (fun sample : Real => samplingRate *
        gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio standardizedShift sample)
      (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (integrable_gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio standardizedShift).const_mul samplingRate
  rw [show (fun sample => sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio samplingRate standardizedShift sample) =
      fun sample => (1 - samplingRate) + samplingRate *
        gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio standardizedShift sample by
    funext sample
    simp [sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio, gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio]]
  rw [integral_add hconst hshift, integral_const, integral_const_mul,
    integral_gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio]
  simp

private theorem gaussianReal_shift_eq_withDensity_likelihood_direct (shift : Real) :
    gaussianReal shift 1 =
      (gaussianReal 0 1).withDensity
        (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio shift sample)) := by
  let likelihood : Real → ENNReal := fun sample =>
    ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio shift sample)
  have hLikelihood : Measurable likelihood := by
    dsimp [likelihood, gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio]
    fun_prop
  rw [gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero shift one_ne_zero,
    gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero 0 one_ne_zero]
  change volume.withDensity (gaussianPDF shift 1) =
    (volume.withDensity (gaussianPDF 0 1)).withDensity likelihood
  rw [← withDensity_mul volume (measurable_gaussianPDF 0 1) hLikelihood]
  apply withDensity_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all _ (fun sample => by
    change gaussianPDF shift 1 sample =
      gaussianPDF 0 1 sample * ENNReal.ofReal
        (gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio shift sample)
    change ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPDFReal shift 1 sample) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 sample) * _
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 sample)]
    congr 1
    rw [gaussianPDFReal, gaussianPDFReal]
    simp only [gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio]
    conv_rhs => rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    norm_num
    ring)

/-- The direct standardized mixture has the displayed density ratio. -/
theorem sparseGaussianMixtureLaw_eq_withDensity
    (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (standardizedShift : Real) :
    (sparseGaussianMixtureLaw samplingRate hRate standardizedShift : Measure Real) =
      (standardGaussianProbabilityMeasure : Measure Real).withDensity
        (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal
          (sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio samplingRate standardizedShift sample)) := by
  let leftLR : Real → ENNReal := fun sample =>
    ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio 0 sample)
  let rightLR : Real → ENNReal := fun sample =>
    ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio standardizedShift sample)
  have hleft : Measurable leftLR := by dsimp [leftLR, gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio]; fun_prop
  have hright : Measurable rightLR := by dsimp [rightLR, gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio]; fun_prop
  have hRateNonneg : 0 ≤ (samplingRate : Real) := NNReal.coe_nonneg samplingRate
  have hRateOne : (samplingRate : Real) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hRate
  have hOneSub : 0 ≤ 1 - (samplingRate : Real) := sub_nonneg.mpr hRateOne
  change ((1 - samplingRate : NNReal) : ENNReal) • gaussianReal 0 1 +
      (samplingRate : ENNReal) • gaussianReal standardizedShift 1 = _
  nth_rewrite 1 [gaussianReal_shift_eq_withDensity_likelihood_direct]
  nth_rewrite 2 [gaussianReal_shift_eq_withDensity_likelihood_direct]
  change ((1 - samplingRate : NNReal) : ENNReal) •
        (gaussianReal 0 1).withDensity leftLR +
      (samplingRate : ENNReal) • (gaussianReal 0 1).withDensity rightLR = _
  rw [← withDensity_smul ((1 - samplingRate : NNReal) : ENNReal) hleft,
    ← withDensity_smul (samplingRate : ENNReal) hright,
    ← withDensity_add_left
      (hleft.const_smul ((1 - samplingRate : NNReal) : ENNReal))]
  apply withDensity_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all _ (fun sample => by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq (1 - samplingRate), NNReal.coe_sub hRate,
      ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq samplingRate]
    dsimp [leftLR, rightLR, gaussianShiftLikelihoodRatio]
    norm_num
    rw [ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq samplingRate,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hRateNonneg]
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add hOneSub
      (mul_nonneg hRateNonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le)]
    congr 1)

/-- Divide a real output by a positive Gaussian noise standard deviation. -/
def positiveGaussianScaleEquiv
    (noiseStddev : NNReal) (hStddev : 0 < noiseStddev) : Real ≃ᵐ Real :=
  (Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ (noiseStddev : Real)⁻¹
    (inv_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hStddev))).toMeasurableEquiv

@[simp] theorem positiveGaussianScaleEquiv_apply
    (noiseStddev : NNReal) (hStddev : 0 < noiseStddev) (sample : Real) :
    positiveGaussianScaleEquiv noiseStddev hStddev sample =
      sample / (noiseStddev : Real) := by
  simp [positiveGaussianScaleEquiv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

theorem gaussianReal_map_positiveGaussianScaleEquiv
    (mean : Real) (noiseStddev : NNReal) (hStddev : 0 < noiseStddev) :
    Measure.map (positiveGaussianScaleEquiv noiseStddev hStddev)
        (gaussianReal mean (noiseStddev ^ 2)) =
      gaussianReal (mean / (noiseStddev : Real)) 1 := by
  rw [Measure.map_congr (ae_of_all _ fun sample =>
    positiveGaussianScaleEquiv_apply noiseStddev hStddev sample)]
  rw [gaussianReal_map_div_const]
  congr 2
  ext
  simp [hStddev.ne']

/-- Direct scaling sends the privacy reference to the standard Gaussian. -/
theorem sampledGaussianOneStepReferenceLaw_map_positiveGaussianScale
    (noiseStddev : NNReal) (hStddev : 0 < noiseStddev) :
    Measure.map (positiveGaussianScaleEquiv noiseStddev hStddev)
        (sampledGaussianOneStepReferenceLaw (noiseStddev ^ 2) : Measure Real) =
      gaussianReal 0 1 := by
  change Measure.map (positiveGaussianScaleEquiv noiseStddev hStddev)
      (gaussianReal 0 (noiseStddev ^ 2)) = _
  rw [gaussianReal_map_positiveGaussianScaleEquiv]
  simp

/-- Direct scaling sends the sampled source to the uncentered standardized mixture. -/
theorem sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw_map_positiveGaussianScale
    (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity : Real) (noiseStddev : NNReal) (hStddev : 0 < noiseStddev) :
    Measure.map (positiveGaussianScaleEquiv noiseStddev hStddev)
        (sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw samplingRate hRate sensitivity
          (noiseStddev ^ 2) : Measure Real) =
      (sparseGaussianMixtureLaw samplingRate hRate
        (sensitivity / (noiseStddev : Real)) : Measure Real) := by
  rw [sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw_eq_gaussianMixture]
  rw [Measure.map_add _ _ (positiveGaussianScaleEquiv noiseStddev hStddev).measurable,
    Measure.map_smul, Measure.map_smul]
  rw [gaussianReal_map_positiveGaussianScaleEquiv,
    gaussianReal_map_positiveGaussianScaleEquiv]
  simp [sparseGaussianMixtureLaw]

/-- Directly normalized sampled source, expressed against its normalized reference. -/
theorem sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw_map_positiveGaussianScale_eq_withDensity
    (samplingRate : NNReal) (hRate : samplingRate ≤ 1)
    (sensitivity : Real) (noiseStddev : NNReal) (hStddev : 0 < noiseStddev) :
    Measure.map (positiveGaussianScaleEquiv noiseStddev hStddev)
        (sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw samplingRate hRate sensitivity
          (noiseStddev ^ 2) : Measure Real) =
      (gaussianReal 0 1).withDensity (fun sample => ENNReal.ofReal
        (sparseGaussianLikelihoodRatio samplingRate
          (sensitivity / (noiseStddev : Real)) sample)) := by
  rw [sampledGaussianOneStepSourceLaw_map_positiveGaussianScale]
  exact sparseGaussianMixtureLaw_eq_withDensity samplingRate hRate _

end

end Mf.DP

     5	/-!
     6	# Exact sampled-Gaussian output laws
     7	
     8	This module defines the one-step neighboring laws, their finite products, the

    10	is a law-construction layer only; moment identities are proved separately.
